title: APPROVE the resolution that certifies that Metro will maintain the 19 New Flyer XCELSIOR 40’ Battery Electric Buses (BEBs) transferred from Lane Transit…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0715, Resolution]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
APPROVE the resolution that certifies that Metro will maintain the 19 New Flyer XCELSIOR 40’ Battery Electric Buses (BEBs) transferred from Lane Transit District (LTD) in revenue service for the remainder of their minimum useful life of 12 years or 500,000 revenue mile, to comply with FTA regulations (Attachment A).
summary: Metro's board would certify that it will keep 19 battery-electric buses transferred from Lane Transit District in revenue service for their remaining useful life, as federal transit rules require.
